items.title: Omni’s Philip Frobos Shares New Sorry & Jane Birkin Covers
items.summary: In 2021, Omni's Philip Frobos released his debut solo album Vague Enough To Satisfy . Since then, he's been busy with the Atlanta post-punk band, who released Souvenir in 2024 and is currently celebrating the anniversary of their debut album Deluxe with a (you guessed it) deluxe version. Now he's back to sharing solo stuff, and this time it's covers of Sorry's 2024 tune "Waxwing" and Jane Birkin's 1973 track "Kawasaki."
